text_block_list.text:
Early one afternoon on a day off, I ran 
into someone unexpected outside an 
open-air café.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Huh, Trainer <username>!?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
G-Good day to you. I never expected to run 
into you in a place like this!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see... it turns out the course 
menu I want is only available for parties 
of two or more.

Trainer Kiryuin was looking at a sign that 
read, 'All-You-Can-Eat Sweets & Bread! 
Come with your lover or friends.'
choice_data_list:
If you're okay with me, want me to keep 
you company?

If you don't mind me, shall I keep you 
company?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? But having you tag along for 
my own personal work is...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I heard from Meek before that this 
restaurant's menu is her favorite.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, I thought being able to 
make it with my own hands would help boost 
her motivation even further!"

"Deeply impressed by our shared calling as 
Trainers, I decided to lend a hand with 
her 'job.'"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...Hm. The whipped cream on this parfait 
seems to prioritize the rich flavor of 
milk over sweetness.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
By pairing it with a berry sauce, the 
aftertaste is surprisingly light and 
refreshing.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Now then, this brûlée cake is... urgh! 
...What a... powerful...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I was able to check over 
every single item on the menu!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Trainer <username>, thank you so very much!
choice_data_list:
Do you think you can make it turn out 
well?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll try making it right away when I 
get back.
And so, a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Please listen! Yesterday, Meek set a new 
fastest record!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"The sweets Trainer made for me cheered me 
right up," she said. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"However, it's still far from complete. I 
have to research more and replicate the 
flavor perfectly!"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I always want to provide top-class support 
for Meek, after all.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
If it's for that sake, I won't spare any 
effort!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Trainer <username>...! Yes, by all means, please do.

Afterward, to thank me for tagging along, 
Trainer Kiryuin shared some homemade 
sweets with me—

I shared and enjoyed the sweets I received 
together with <chrname>.
